Class ConnectionMcpClient

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.mcp.client.langchain4j.ConnectionMcpClient
All Implemented Interfaces:
dev.langchain4j.mcp.client.McpClient, AutoCloseable
@Internal public final class ConnectionMcpClient extends Object implements dev.langchain4j.mcp.client.McpClient
An McpClient that resolves the client bean of a connection when it is first used, so that a server that cannot be reached fails the calls to its client, which the tool providers skip, instead of the creation of the tool providers. There is one per connection, shared by the tool providers and the health indicator.

Only one attempt to create the client runs at a time: the calls made while it runs fail at once with a McpClientConnectingException instead of waiting for it, and a failed attempt is made again by the next call. A failure is logged as a warning when the connection becomes unavailable, and its recovery when it becomes available again.

Since:
2.2.0
